algorithms.name: R-ed-UCB (stochastic, sliding window h = floor(eps N))

symbols.gamma_max: upper bound on the per-pull increments gamma_i(n), gamma_max <= 1

source.label: thr:nonLearnable
source.quote: Let $\mathcal{M}_1(\gamma_{\max})$ be the set of $2$-armed non-decreasing (Assumption~\ref{ass:incr}) deterministic rested bandit with $\gamma_i(n) \le \gamma_{\max} \le 1$ for all $i \in [K]$ and $n \in \Nat$. For every learning policy $\pi$, it holds that: \sup_{\bm{\mu} \in \mathcal{M}_1(\gamma_{\max})} R_{\bm{\mu}}(\pi, T) \ge \left\lfloor \frac{\gamma_{\max}}{12} T \right\rfloor.

results.notes: Linear lower bound: non-learnability without concavity. Regret is against optimal policy (policy regret).

source.label: thr:nonLearnable2
source.quote: Let $\mathcal{M}_2$ be the set of $2$-armed rising (Assumptions~\ref{ass:incr} and~\ref{ass:decrDeriv}) deterministic rested bandit. For every learning policy $\pi$, it holds that: \sup_{\bm{\mu} \in \mathcal{M}_2} R_{\bm{\mu}}(\pi, T) \ge \left\lfloor  \frac{T}{64} \right\rfloor.

symbols.beta_ind: beta in [0,1): instances may be identical only up to floor(T^beta) pulls

conditions: instances in the class can be identical only up to floor(T^beta) <= T/2 pulls, beta in [0,1)

source.label: thr:Learnablebeta
source.quote: Let  $\beta \in [0,1)$ and $\mathcal{M}_{2,\beta}$ be the set of $2$-armed rising (Assumptions~\ref{ass:incr} and~\ref{ass:decrDeriv}) deterministic rested bandit that can be identical only up to $\lfloor T^{\beta} \rfloor \le \frac{T}{2}$ pull. For every learning policy $\pi$, it holds that: \sup_{\bm{\mu} \in \mathcal{M}_{2,\beta}} R_{\bm{\mu}}(\pi, T) \ge  \left\lfloor \frac{T^{\beta}}{32} \right\rfloor.

results.notes: Defined via the restricted indistinguishability class; recorded on the deterministic rising setting with the class restriction in conditions.

symbols.beta_ind: beta in [0,1): instances may be identical up to floor(T^beta) pulls

conditions: instances in the class can be identical up to floor(T^beta) <= T/2 pulls, beta in [0,1)

source.label: thr:apprendiamopoco
source.quote: Let $\beta \in [0,1)$ and let $\mathcal{N}_{2,\beta}$ be the set of $2$-armed rising (Assumptions~\ref{ass:incr} and~\ref{ass:decrDeriv}) rested bandit with Normal reward and unit variance that can be identical up to $\lfloor T^{\beta} \rfloor \le \frac{T}{2}$ pulls. For every learning policy $\pi$, it holds that: \sup_{\bm{\mu} \in \mathcal{N}_{2,\beta}} R_{\bm{\mu}}(\pi, T) \ge  \frac{\lfloor T^{\beta} + T^{\frac{2}{3}} \rfloor}{64 \sqrt{e}}.

results.notes: Gives Omega(T^{2/3}) even for beta=0 in the stochastic case.

symbols.q: exponent in [0,1] of the cumulative increment
symbols.Upsilon_T_q: cumulative increment Upsilon_mu(T,q) = sum_{l=1}^{T-1} max_i gamma_i(l)^q of the instance

conditions: class of instances with Upsilon_mu(T,q) >= Upsilon_bar

source.label: thr:nonLearnable3
source.quote: Let $q \in [0,1]$, $\overline{\Upsilon} \ge 0$,  and $\mathcal{M}_2(\overline{\Upsilon})$ be the set of $2$-armed rising (Assumptions~\ref{ass:incr} and~\ref{ass:decrDeriv}) deterministic rested bandit such that ${\Upsilon_{\bm{\mu}}(T,q)} \ge {\overline{\Upsilon}}$. For every learning policy $\pi$, it holds that: \sup_{\bm{\mu} \in \mathcal{M}_2(\overline{\Upsilon})} \frac{R_{\bm{\mu}}(\pi, T)}{\Upsilon_{\bm{\mu}}(T,q)} \ge \frac{T^q}{8}.

results.notes: Statement is on the sup of the ratio R/Upsilon; recorded as R >= T^q Upsilon/8 for the worst instance in the class.

symbols.Upsilon_TK_q: cumulative increment Upsilon_mu(ceil(T/K), q) = sum_{l=1}^{ceil(T/K)-1} max_i gamma_i(l)^q

conditions: expected rewards in [0,1], non-decreasing and concave
tuning: B_i(t) = mu_bar_i^{R-ed}(t) (last reward + (t - N) * last increment)

source.label: thr:theRegretDetRested
source.quote: Let $T \in \Nat$, then \algrested (Algorithm~\ref{alg:alg}) with $B_i(t) \equiv \overline{\mu}_i^{\text{\red}}(t)$ suffers an expected regret bounded, for every $q \in [0,1]$, as: R_{\bm{\mu}}(\text{\algrested},T) \le 2K + K T^q  \Upsilon_{\bm{\mu}}\left(\left\lceil \frac{T}{K} \right\rceil,q \right).

results.notes: Appendix B specializes: gamma <= e^{-cl} gives O((K/c) log T); gamma <= l^{-c}, c>1 gives O(K T^{1/c} log T). Index does not use T, so anytime.

symbols.Upsilon_eps_q: cumulative increment Upsilon_mu(ceil((1-2 eps) T/K), q)

conditions: expected rewards in [0,1], non-decreasing and concave
tuning: B_i = windowed estimator + sigma (t - N + h - 1) sqrt(10 log(1/delta_t)/h^3)

source.label: thr:theRegretRestedStochastic
source.quote: Let $T \in \Nat$, then \algrested (Algorithm~\ref{alg:alg}) with $B_i(t) \equiv  \widehat{\mu}_i^{\text{\red},h_{i,t}}(t) + \beta_i^{\text{\red},h_{i,t}}(t)$,  $h_{i,t} = \left\lfloor \epsilon N_{i,t-1}\right\rfloor$ for $\epsilon \in (0,1/2)$ and $\delta_t = t^{-\alpha}$ for $\alpha > 2$, suffers an expected regret bounded, for every $q \in \left[0,  1 \right]$, as: R \le \BigO ( \frac{K}{\epsilon} (\sigma  T)^{\frac{2}{3}} ( \alpha  \log T )^{\frac{1}{3}} +   \frac{K {T}^q }{1-2\epsilon}  \Upsilon_{\bm{\mu}}(\lceil  (1-2\epsilon) \frac{T}{K} \rceil,q ) ).

results.notes: Proof gives explicit constants (3K/eps (2 sigma T)^{2/3}(10 alpha log T)^{1/3} etc.). Figure: O~(K T^{2/3}) when gamma_i(l) <= l^{-c} with c > 3/2 or exponential decay. Index uses sigma but not T.
